description: This file defines the 'PublicLayout' React component, which provides the layout for public pages including navigation, main content area with animation, and footer. It also includes a helper component 'PublicTopNav' for the navigation bar with links and authentication controls.

methods.name: PublicLayout
methods.description: React functional component that renders the main public layout, including header, main content with fade-in animation, and footer.

methods.name: PublicTopNav
methods.description: React functional component that renders the top navigation bar with links to Home and Dashboard, and includes authentication controls.
